name: Renaissance Global Ltd (RGL)
tagline: Branded/owned-jewellery exporter (Irasva, Enchanted Disney, Hallmark, luxury D2C brand Jean Dousset) pivoting from commodity B2B manufacturing toward higher-margin owned brands and US D2C retail, but capital efficiency (ROCE ~9.3%, ROE ~6.5% 3yr avg) hasn't caught up to the growth story yet.
business_overview: Renaissance Global (formerly Renaissance Jewellery) designs, manufactures and retails jewellery/gems/diamonds, historically as a B2B supplier to global retailers, now pivoting toward owned/licensed brands (Irasva, Enchanted Disney, Hallmark) and a luxury D2C chain (Jean Dousset, expanding from 2 to 5 US stores in CY26, ~Rs 25 Cr capex).
fundamentals_table: Poor 6.73% over 5 years; recent quarter revenue +30.1% YoY (owned brands +28.8%); D2C US segment +50% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: The owned-brand/D2C pivot is real and accelerating (D2C US +50% YoY, Jean Dousset LA flagship ~Rs 25 Cr/yr, 30% of that brand's revenue), and overall revenue growth has picked up sharply in recent quarters versus a poor 5-year trend. But ROCE (9.31%) and 3-year ROE (6.50%) remain weak, meaning the strategic shift has not yet shown up as improved capital efficiency - this reads as an early-stage brand-building story, not yet a demonstrated moat or compounding return profile.
